consent.title: Garmin Wearables Study
consent.intro: You are about to start the process of donating your Garmin wearable data to our study. The data that we ask you to donate will be used for academic research to gain insight into physical activity, sleep, and wellbeing behaviors. Only health-related data is extracted: daily movement summaries (including wear time, stress, Body Battery, and respiration), VO2max estimates, recorded activities, sleep, and the device model. Personal details such as your name, email address, location, and device serial numbers are never read or transmitted.
consent.process: We will walk you through this process step by step. During this process no data is stored or sent to a server. You can filter by date, exclude activity types, and delete rows from the data before donating. Data will only be donated and stored when you click the button "Yes, donate" on the page that shows your data.
agreementPoints: you fully and voluntarily agree to donate your data for this research.
you are aware that when your data is used for academic publications, or made publicly available in some other form, this will be anonymous.
you are aware that you have the right to withdraw your permission.
consent.agreementCheckbox: I have read and agree with the above terms.

upload.title: Upload File
upload.intro: Please request a copy of your Garmin data: sign in at garmin.com, open Account Settings → Data Management → Export Your Data (garmin.com/account/datamanagement/exportdata) and click "Request Data Export". Garmin will email you a download link within about 48 hours. Download the .zip file from that email and upload it here without unpacking it.
upload.processing: Processing your file... This may take a few moments for large exports.
upload.incorrectFile: The uploaded file might be incorrect, corrupted, or void of Garmin health data.
upload.possibleIssues: We were unable to find any recognizable Garmin health data in the uploaded file. This could mean:
issuePoints: The file is not a Garmin data export
The export was unpacked and re-zipped, changing its folder structure
The file is corrupted or incomplete
The account has no wellness, sleep, or activity data
upload.checkFile: Please check that you have uploaded the original Garmin export .zip or contact the researchers for assistance.
upload.note: Note: The process to extract the correct data from the file is done on your own computer. No data is stored or sent yet. Extraction may take a while for large exports.

filter.intro: Determine whether you would like to donate the data below. Carefully check the data and adjust when required. You can filter by date range and exclude specific activity types. With your donation you contribute to the previously described research. Thank you in advance.
filter.donationPrompt: Do you want to donate the above data?
filter.note: Note: Sending the data may take several seconds depending on the data size.

thankyou.title: Thank You!
thankyou.successMessage: Your data has been successfully submitted. Thank you for your contribution!
thankyou.saveId: Please save this ID for your records.
thankyou.declineMessage: Thank you for your time. Your decision has been recorded and no data has been shared.
